record.one_liner: Google's API for programmatic management, reporting and ad management of Google Ads accounts and campaigns.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 user flow (desktop/web app) plus service account flow (graded as other); every call also needs a 22-character developer token sent in the developer-token header (api_key). login-customer-id header needed for manager accounts.
record.access_notes: Test Account Access is available on a self-serve Cloud project, but production accounts need Basic or Standard access, applied for through the Google Ads API Overview page.
record.api_notes: Docs describe the REST interface alongside the primary client libraries; no GraphQL. Covers campaigns, ad groups, assets, labels and GAQL reporting.
record.blocker_notes: Test access works for test accounts immediately; production account use needs an access-level application review (Explorer/Basic/Standard).

evidence.quote: Both OAuth 2.0 user authentication flow and service account flow are supported.
A developer token is required in the developer-token HTTP header for every API call.
You start with Test Account Access and can apply to increase your access level through additional steps.
apply for Explorer access on the Google Ads API Overview page to access production accounts
is a 22-character alphanumeric string obtained from the API Center page of your Google Ads manager account.
